purpose: Test whether three natural source-preserving micro-edit factors reduce a resolvable detector score without sacrificing fidelity, strict genre, source-relative C2, or style.

factors.hypothesis: Removing one optional evaluative frame while retaining the proposition may reduce a predictable AI-polish signal.
factors.not_a_recipe: The edit must be locally justified by tone and may not remove a qualification, attribution, or factual claim.

factors.hypothesis: Replacing one abstract/rhetorical subject with a direct actor that makes the same claim may reduce an AI-polish signal.
factors.not_a_recipe: The actor and evidential strength must remain the same; arbitrary active-voice conversion is not allowed.

factors.hypothesis: Replacing one metaphorical or nominalized restatement with a direct, source-supported equivalent may reduce an AI-polish signal.
factors.not_a_recipe: The edit cannot simplify technical content, delete modality, or change the claim.

procedure: Scan every frozen candidate once in ZeroGPT and Scribbr in factor order f1, f2, f3 and sample order arxiv, news.
After terminal state, recompute the full visible candidate SHA-256; stale or mismatched observations are invalid.
A candidate advances to repeats only if ZeroGPT improves beyond that sample's frozen baseline noise and Scribbr does not worsen by more than 5 points.
Repeat each advancing candidate in both services until n=3; do not repeat a failed candidate.
Do not create, combine, or alter a candidate after any micro-01 score is visible.
Attempt Copyleaks once only on the lowest-edit-cost advancing candidate if the guest UI is usable; blocked/error is not a score.

success_criteria.factor_screen_success: The same factor improves ZeroGPT beyond baseline noise on both samples, has no Scribbr regression over 5 points, and completes required repeats.
success_criteria.effect_size_reporting: Report median delta, score range, and delta per changed percent separately for every sample/service.
success_criteria.hard_pass_is_not_required: This is a causal micro-effect experiment; a score may remain above 20%.
success_criteria.rule_admission: Even a screen success remains calibration evidence and requires a new preregistered holdout before entering production skill.

stopping_rules: If no frozen factor succeeds on both samples, stop without adaptive edits.
If a candidate fails fidelity, English-level, or style on reinspection, do not scan it.
Do not expand edit budget in micro-01.
Do not infer a Copyleaks result from a blocked or loading UI.
